description: Engagement and gamification config, tuned for a corporate setting (team-based competition reduces individual pressure and drives return visits). Values are starting points to balance during the platform build.

badges.name: Level Cleared
badges.criteria: Complete all lessons + mini-project in a level.

streaks.note: A freeze protects a streak for one missed day.

leaderboards.name: Team / Department
leaderboards.note: Department-vs-department keeps it collaborative, not anxiety-inducing.

spacedRepetition.note: Resurfaces past questions for retention rather than one-and-done.

certificates.note: Issued on pathway completion; a strong motivator in enterprise.

placementQuiz.effect: Suggests a pathway and offers to let strong users test out of early lessons; never restricts access.
